_note: Round 119 (Robert, 2026-10-13): 'During blacksmithing allow for player to design the look of the gear and it can potentially increase or decrease the items bonuses or attributes in unique ways. Same for all crafting.' Each craft has a design section; a choice has a name, a skill needed, an item it costs, what it does to the numbers (ward_mult, hp_mult, weight_mult, value_mult and 'effect' like a technique's), and what it looks like (color, glow). Pluses always come with minuses. scripts/systems/Design.gd reads this. Dev writes the words.

plain.name: Plain
plain.desc: No ornament. Nothing gained, nothing lost.

studded.name: Studded
studded.desc: Rows of studs. More ward, heavier.

filigree.name: Filigree
filigree.desc: Fine wirework. A little less ward, a little more qi, worth more.

flared.name: Flared plates
flared.desc: Wide, stout plates. Strong ward, heavy, less to wear it on.

runic.name: Runic lines
runic.desc: Glowing cut lines. Harder strikes, a touch more fragile.

scaled.name: Scaled plates
scaled.desc: Overlapping scales. More ward, a little slower.

feathered.name: Feathered
feathered.desc: Light plumes and cutaways. Quicker, less ward.

spiral.name: Spiral lines
spiral.desc: Wound lines that lead qi round. Qi and calm.

thorned.name: Thorned
thorned.desc: Hooked spines. You hit harder; so does everything else.

lacquered.name: Lacquered
lacquered.desc: Layered and polished. Tougher, worth more, heavier.

sunburst.name: Sunburst
sunburst.desc: Rays of inlay. Finds go your way.

moonlit.name: Moonlit
moonlit.desc: Cold lines that drink the dark. A stiller mind, a softer guard.

stormwork.name: Stormwork
stormwork.desc: Forked lines of arc-light. Fast, and the lightning gets you too.

dragonbone.name: Dragonbone ridges
dragonbone.desc: Ridged like a spine. Strong everywhere, heavy everywhere.

silver.name: Silver trim
silver.desc: Costs a silver ore. A little qi and a little worth.

gold.name: Gold trim
gold.desc: Costs a gold nugget. Better finds, heavier purse to lose.

jade.name: Jade inlay
jade.desc: Costs a rough jade. Calmer qi, softer plates (a little less ward).

copper.name: Copper trim
copper.desc: Costs a brass cog. Warm and cheap. A little worth.

obsidian.name: Obsidian edge
obsidian.desc: Costs an obsidian edge. Hard black edging; keen.

moonsilver.name: Moonsilver
moonsilver.desc: Costs mirror silver. Pale and calm.

pearl.name: Pearl inlay
pearl.desc: Costs a pearl. Gentle waters, gentle worth.

imperial.name: Imperial gilt
imperial.desc: Costs an imperial seal. Rich, heavy, a purse for thieves.

midnight.name: Midnight
midnight.desc: Blued dark. Harder to spot (a touch more dodge), dull to sell.

crimson.name: Crimson
crimson.desc: Blood red. Fiercer, a little more taken.

bone.name: Bone white
bone.desc: Pale. Plain to look at, kind to the purse.

obsid.name: Obsidian black
obsid.desc: Total black. A little dodge, a little gloom.

sunset.name: Sunset
sunset.desc: Orange to red. Fierce and showy.

fire.desc: Costs one fire-aspect material (the cheapest you carry; a richer one infuses more strongly). The right method makes it take; the wrong one fights it. You will learn which by trying.

plain.name: No method
plain.desc: Just add it. Without a method the aspect only half takes.

fold.name: Fold
fold.desc: Fold the work over itself again and again. Which aspect likes it? Try and see.

quench.name: Quench
quench.desc: Plunge it hot into something cold. Which aspect likes it? Try and see.

bed.name: Bed
bed.desc: Bed it in the ground to settle. Which aspect likes it? Try and see.

layer.name: Layer
layer.desc: Build it up in thin bonded layers. Which aspect likes it? Try and see.

bind.name: Bind
bind.desc: Bind it in something living. Which aspect likes it? Try and see.

slender.name: Slender vial
slender.desc: Concentrated: stronger, a little less to sell.

wide.name: Wide flask
wide.desc: Makes two, each a little weaker.

twin.name: Twin-chambered
twin.desc: Two doses, almost full strength. Costs a silver ore.

gourd.name: Gourd flask
gourd.desc: Fat and slow. Makes a stronger dose, rarely.

bamboo.name: Bamboo tube
bamboo.desc: Light and cheap. A little weaker.

spirit.name: Spirit-herb tincture
spirit.desc: Costs a spirit herb. More qi, a touch less healing. Herbalism 1.

ember.name: Ember-root tincture
ember.desc: Costs an ember root. Stronger healing, a bit less qi. Herbalism 2.

moon.name: Moonpetal tincture
moon.desc: Costs a moonpetal. A fine, balanced lift. Herbalism 4.

venom.name: Venom-reed tincture
venom.desc: Costs a venom reed. Sharp: more qi, less healing.

lotus.name: Frost-lotus tincture
lotus.desc: Costs a frost lotus. Cooling: more healing.

pearl.name: Pearl-dust tincture
pearl.desc: Costs a pearl. Fine and rich.

jade.name: Jade stopper
jade.desc: Costs a rough jade. A little stronger, worth more.

gold.name: Gold-sealed
gold.desc: Costs a gold nugget. Prized, hardly stronger.

amber.name: Amber seal
amber.desc: Costs old amber. Keeps for years: sells high.

draught.desc: Much stronger, but the body pays: less qi.

cabochon.name: Cabochon
cabochon.desc: Smooth and calming. Worth a little less.

brilliant.name: Brilliant cut
brilliant.desc: Sharpens the eye for the killing blow, and the thief's eye too.

marquise.name: Marquise
marquise.desc: Long and sharp. Hits land harder.

star.name: Star cut
star.desc: Rays of light. Worth much more.

briolette.name: Briolette
briolette.desc: Teardrop facets all round. A lucky finder.

void.name: Void cut
void.desc: Takes light in. Calm, deep and cheap to sell.

claw.name: Claw setting
claw.desc: Bites into the wearer's strikes; a touch more taken.

bezel.name: Bezel setting
bezel.desc: Snug and safe: a little dodge, a little less strike.

prong.name: Crown prongs
prong.desc: Lets the light in. A little more qi, a little less guard.

cage.name: Wire cage
cage.desc: Holds loosely and lightly. Quicker hands.

ward.name: Warded setting
ward.desc: Rune-cut seat. More dodge, less strike.

blackened.name: Blackened
blackened.desc: Dull and hard to see. A little less taken, worth less.
